text: The initiative has documented progress in risk knowledge, mainstreaming disaster risk reduction in planning, and protecting critical infrastructure. Multiple slope stabilization works and hazard mapping activities have been completed, and coordination has improved. However, there is a need for more detailed landslide-specific metrics and strengthened monitoring frameworks.

metadata.solution_name: Government-led Landslide Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Fiji (2020–2025)
